name: CA-38
label: Safe D

key_factors: Solis's large fundraising edge over Casas
Prediction markets price a Democratic win near 94%
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly Democratic: the redrawn district leans D by 8 points, Hilda Solis has raised over $1 million with outside support while Pedro Casas reports no fundraising, and Polymarket prices her near 94%. With no polls or expert ratings to contradict this, the race stays at a roughly 19.5-point Democratic margin.
model.watch: Any late polling showing a closer race, or a surge of Republican outside spending, would be the first sign the margin is narrowing.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; fundamentals point clearly one way (post-redistricting), so it is treated as safe for that party.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
This open Los Angeles-area seat was redrawn to favor Democrats by about 8 points, and the candidate landscape reinforces that tilt. Hilda Solis, a well-known local Democrat, has raised more than $1 million and drawn outside support with no opposition spending against her, while Republican Pedro Casas shows no reported fundraising. Prediction markets give Solis roughly a 94% chance of winning.

With no general-election polls or expert ratings available, the forecast rests on fundamentals, money, and market pricing. Those all point the same direction, suggesting a comfortable Democratic win of roughly 19 to 20 points, though the absence of polling keeps uncertainty somewhat elevated.
